purpose_context: The events domain's Java services now live in spec-kitty-events (ADR 2026-10-29-1). Core needs one dependable way to consume a released service build: a pinned, checksummed reference, a verified download into a shared cache for developers, CI and users, and a launcher that fails closed with a named reason and remedy. The same mechanism serves the charter backend service (#6590) and the write-service launcher (#6676).
purpose_tldr: Core pins, fetches, verifies and launches the backend service binaries released by spec-kitty-events (and later spec-kitty-charter), and refuses to run without a verified one.
